name: Chanya Srisawat
bio:
Chanya's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a childhood karting obsession, but through a university project focused on supply chain optimization. Her meticulous nature and problem-solving skills quickly found a home in the high-pressure world of racing logistics. She started as an intern, learning the ropes of coordinating transport, customs, and equipment, quickly rising through the ranks due to her exceptional organizational abilities. 

At Cavaleiro Sports, Chanya is the linchpin that ensures everything arrives on time and in perfect condition. She's known for her proactive approach, anticipating potential bottlenecks and implementing solutions before they become problems. Her eye for detail is legendary; from the precise packing of spare parts to the seamless coordination of travel arrangements, Chanya ensures the team can focus on the track. She's not just a logistics coordinator; she's a guardian of efficiency.

What sets Chanya apart is her holistic view of logistics as a competitive advantage. She constantly seeks innovative ways to streamline processes, reduce costs, and improve the team's overall performance. While Cavaleiro Sports has seen their share of success, Chanya is often the unsung hero ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. She views her role as not just transporting equipment, but as a critical part of the team's pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often pulled back in a neat ponytail
physical.description: Chanya is a petite woman with a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to casual meetings.
Has a lucky charm (a small Buddha amulet) she keeps on her desk.
